event_summary: A small pale rectangular block visibly travels around the top of a stationary-looking black circular base while nearby objects remain still.
raw_event_description: The scene shows a wooden tabletop with a black circular base on the right, a small pale rectangular block on its top surface, a tilted metallic object with a purple strip on the left, and a cable extending from the black base toward the right. Over the video, the pale block changes position on the black circular top from the front/right area toward the left edge, then toward the upper/back area of the circle, with its visible orientation also changing. The black circular base stays in the same table location, and the left metallic object, purple strip, cable, table, and wall show no visible independent motion.

reasons: The main objects are fully visible on the tabletop.
The small pale block is already present on the black circular base at the start.
No separate start trigger is visible in the first frame.
